note: Curated by myRock. One block per week, the app shows the latest week that has started. IMDb ratings rounded, they can move by a tenth.

weeks.title: Crime, classics and a bit of Malta

films.title: The Godfather
films.about: The Corleone family runs New York's underworld until a shooting forces the quiet youngest son, Michael, into the family business. Three hours that fly.
films.take: The one everyone quotes. Watch it before someone ruins it for you.

films.title: Gladiator
films.about: A Roman general is betrayed, enslaved and forced to fight as a gladiator, with one goal: revenge on the emperor who destroyed his family.
films.take: Local flex: big chunks were shot at Fort Ricasoli in Kalkara.

films.title: Casablanca
films.about: In wartime Morocco, a cynical bar owner's life gets complicated when the woman who broke his heart walks into his café needing his help.
films.take: Black and white, zero boring. Half your favourite lines come from here.

films.title: Pulp Fiction
films.awards: Palme d'Or, Oscar for Best Original Screenplay
films.about: Hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers collide in LA, told out of order and somehow it all clicks.
films.take: Snacks ready. The dialogue is the main character.

films.title: Parasite
films.about: A broke family cons its way, one job at a time, into the house of a rich one. Then the house reveals a secret.
films.take: Go in knowing nothing. Subtitles, worth it.

films.title: Back to the Future
films.awards: Oscar for Best Sound Effects Editing
films.about: A teenager is accidentally sent back to 1955 in a time-travelling DeLorean and has to make sure his parents still fall in love.
films.take: Feel-good certified. Great one for the family sofa.

films.title: Heat
films.about: An obsessive LA detective chases a disciplined professional thief planning one last big score. Two legends, one diner scene.
films.take: That shootout still sets the bar.

films.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
films.about: A legendary concierge and his lobby boy get caught up in a stolen painting, a family fortune and a very fast chase across a made-up European country.
films.take: Pastel-perfect and properly funny. Peak aesthetic.

films.title: Spirited Away
films.about: A girl stumbles into a spirit world, her parents get turned into pigs, and she has to work in a bathhouse for gods to get them back.
films.take: Animation for grown-ups too. Pure magic.

films.title: Se7en
films.about: Two detectives, one about to retire and one brand new, hunt a killer who builds each murder around one of the seven deadly sins.
films.take: Dark, rainy and that ending. Not a first-date pick.

films.title: Roman Holiday
films.about: A bored princess escapes her schedule in Rome and spends one wild day with an American reporter who knows exactly who she is.
films.take: Vespa, gelato, Audrey. The original soft-life movie.

films.title: Superbad
films.about: Two best friends try to score drinks for a party before school ends and they go to different universities. Nothing goes to plan.
films.take: Turn your brain off and laugh. McLovin forever.

weeks.title: Gangsters, legends and Malta on screen

films.title: Goodfellas
films.awards: Oscar for Best Supporting Actor (Joe Pesci)
films.about: The true story of Henry Hill, from kid running errands for the mob to a life of money, cars and paranoia.
films.take: Fast, funny, brutal. Scorsese at full speed.

films.title: Munich
films.about: After the 1972 Olympics attack, a secret team is sent across Europe to track down the men behind it, and the mission starts to break them.
films.take: Spot Valletta: Malta doubles for several cities in this one.

films.title: Some Like It Hot
films.about: Two musicians who witness a mob hit hide from gangsters by dressing as women and joining an all-female band. Then they meet Marilyn.
films.take: Still one of the funniest films ever made. That last line.

films.title: The Dark Knight
films.awards: 2 Oscars, including Best Supporting Actor (Heath Ledger)
films.about: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal who just wants to watch Gotham burn and keeps forcing everyone into impossible choices.
films.take: Superhero movie that plays like a crime epic.

films.title: Amélie
films.about: A shy waitress in Paris secretly fixes the lives of people around her, while being too scared to chase her own crush.
films.take: Cosy, quirky, very French. Perfect rainy night pick.

films.title: The Shawshank Redemption
films.about: A banker sentenced to life for a murder he swears he didn't commit spends decades in prison, and never gives up hope.
films.take: The highest rated film on IMDb for a reason.

films.title: Knives Out
films.about: A famous crime writer dies after his birthday party, and a very Southern detective decides the whole messy family are suspects.
films.take: Whodunit with jokes. Chris Evans' jumper is iconic.

films.title: Psycho
films.about: A woman on the run checks into a quiet roadside motel run by a polite young man and his mother. Bad choice.
films.take: The shower scene that changed horror forever.

films.title: The Departed
films.about: An undercover cop inside Boston's mob and a mob spy inside the police race to find each other first.
films.take: Twists until the very last shot.

films.title: Interstellar
films.about: With Earth dying, a former pilot leaves his kids to travel through a wormhole looking for a new home for humanity.
films.take: Big screen, loud volume, tissues nearby.

films.title: Coco
films.about: A boy who dreams of music ends up in the colourful Land of the Dead and has to uncover his family's real story before sunrise.
films.take: You will cry. Everybody does.

films.title: Popeye
films.about: The spinach-loving sailor arrives in the seaside town of Sweethaven looking for his long-lost dad and falls for Olive Oyl.
films.take: Not a masterpiece, but the whole village was built in Mellieħa and it's still there.
